description: Tell the convert.express team about a bug, a missing feature, or a question — from you or your user. A human reads every message; there is no automatic reply. Include reply_email only if your user wants an answer.

message.description: The message in plain text. Up to 2000 characters are kept.

reply_email.description: Email address for a human reply, only with your user's consent.

robot_key.description: Pass the robot_key from your earlier jobs so all your jobs stay together. Omit on your very first call — a new one is returned.

type.description: What kind of message this is.

name: send_feedback
title: Send feedback
